description: Returns all accessible groups with pagination and filtering.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (max 5000 for ids_only)

parameters.name: filters[created_before]
parameters.description: Filter groups created before this ISO date-time

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: Filter by updated_at range in ISO format (start...end)

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: JSON array of group IDs to filter by

parameters.name: filters[context_id]
parameters.description: Context ID to filter groups by

parameters.name: filters[context_type_id]
parameters.description: Context type ID to filter by

parameters.name: filters[subcontext_type_id]
parameters.description: Sub-context type ID to filter by
